text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said Monday it is proposing to expand the previously authorized Telephony Group series of its common stock.
The company said the move would be intended to reflect the performance of substantially all of its TCI Group international and noncable, non-programming domestic assets.
The company said the new series would track assets such as its interest in Teleport, Sprint PCS, Home, Tele-Communications International Inc, United Video Satellite Group Inc and others.
The company said the tracking stock may be issued through an exchange offer in which shareholders would have the opportunity to exchange their TCI Group stock for tracking stock of the new group.
